digest.component_or_area: documentation generation and config reference tooling
propositions: A new gen_config_reference.py generator must produce fully-generated docs/config-reference.md and docs/security.md by reading typed config schema, deprecation registry (cfg-kind entries), and secret-name inventory, with a curated template for narrative topics.
The generator must output docs with a top-of-file banner naming 'python scripts/gen_config_reference.py' within the first 8 lines to satisfy test_generated_surface_markers.py requirements.
Both generated docs must be registered in the GENERATED map and docs/README.md table, and their drift must be detectable via gen.main(['--check']) returning nonzero when stale.
The existing docs/config.md must remain byte-unchanged with all its consumers (content-asserting tests and anchor deep links) intact; the generator must never target it.

A topic-coverage test must verify that across both generated docs, every required topic (precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure) has a corresponding anchor.
The --check drift gate must normalize newlines (CRLF/LF) to prevent false failures on autocrlf checkouts and run portably under make test with no CI provider dependency.
